title: FactRecord
description: Immutable evidence row of the K1 fact log (Wave-1 design-gate schema freeze). Governing inputs: S0_GOAL_ADR.md section 2 (rubric items 8/10) and section 1 (freeze discipline); FAULT_DISCOVERY_REQUIREMENTS.md FR-1..FR-3 (E1-E7); CURRENT_CAPABILITY_MAP.md T0/T1/T2 semantics. Authoritative goal (verbatim): 构建一个 Agent，能够从源代码中发现固件/软件故障机制，并推导出相应的故障检测/诊断规则。

fact_id.description: Unique stable identifier of this evidence row (e.g. F-C1-0007). Referenced by MECHANISM_HYPOTHESIS_SCHEMA.json and RULECARD_SCHEMA.json through the canonical factRef shape defined below.

source_snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the frozen source snapshot (repository tree state) this evidence was collected from; fixed before measurement per S0-Q1 freeze discipline.

build_snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the frozen build/index snapshot (compile_commands.json plus fw-context index state) backing the evidence surface.

repository.description: Repository or fixture identifier, including corpus lineage (A/B/C per WAVE1_CORPUS_MATRIX.md).

commit.description: Full commit hash or fixture revision tag of the examined tree.

file.description: Path of the primary evidence file relative to the repository root. For the build_manifest_diff surface this is the manifest path.

range_start.description: 1-based start line of the cited region. 0 only when the surface yields no line range (e.g. build_manifest_diff).

range_end.description: 1-based inclusive end line of the cited region; must be greater than or equal to range_start. 0 only when no line range applies.

evidence_surface.description: Surface that produced the row. fw_context_read_file = ifdef-filtered active-mode file read (T0 for multi-line regions). fw_context_list_conditional_regions = conditional skeleton of the active build (T0). fw_context_explain_condition = condition text and macro_inputs only, run-pinned context_id (T0, condition text only). fw_context_find_callers = proven direct call/reference edges. fw_context_lookup_symbol = exact-name symbol existence and definition rows. fw_context_search = any other fw-context FTS/semantic search surface (search_code/search_bodies/search_content/smart_search). independent_grep = raw-disk grep/rg outside the substrate (FR-8). independent_clang_e = WSL clang -E preprocessor instrument (FR-8). build_manifest_diff = out-of-band G1 build-manifest diff. other_independent = any other independent channel; it must name the channel in provenance.instrument. Substrate output is never ground truth (E1).

exact_query.description: Verbatim query or command issued to the surface (tool name with full parameters, grep pattern, clang -E command). No paraphrase; this is the replayable query chain required by E3.

raw_artifact_ref.description: Path or URI of the retained unmodified raw output artifact. Substrate output is stored as provenance, never as ground truth (E1).

trust_class.description: T0 = directly trusted WITHIN the named scope recorded in this row (still provenance-carrying, never ground truth); T1 = gateway-safe, usable ONLY as a K1-mediated fail-closed claim; T2 = quarantined, labeled degraded provenance, never load-bearing. Semantics: CURRENT_CAPABILITY_MAP.md; usage duties: FAULT_DISCOVERY_REQUIREMENTS.md FR-2 (E2).

instrument.description: Exact tool/instrument and version (e.g. fw-context-mcp 0.31.0, rg version, clang version in WSL). For the other_independent surface this names the channel.

channel.description: Retrieval channel class: in-band substrate, independent raw-disk, independent preprocessor, out-of-band build manifest, or other named independent channel.

k1_mediated.description: True when the claim passed through the K1 evidence gateway (mandatory for all T1 claims). False is allowed only for T0 direct claims and independent channels.

certainty.description: measured = directly observed via a T0/T1-scoped surface; attested = observed and corroborated by an independent channel; inferred = derived by deterministic replayable reasoning from other facts; degraded = from a T2 or otherwise weakened surface, labeled per E2/E6 and never load-bearing.

polarity.description: positive = presence or holding claim; negative = absence claim (must enumerate attempts per E4/E7); lower_bound = truncated or incomplete enumeration admissible only as a lower bound (G7).

context_identity.description: Build/variant identity the claim is pinned to (config hash, variant/image, active build context). Reuse of the claim outside this identity drops it to the stricter applicable trust class (E2).

detector_checks.description: IDs of guard detectors applied to this row (G1..G9 per DETECTOR_ADMISSION_MATRIX.md), e.g. G1 build-manifest diff, G7 truncation detection, G8 macro-value policing.

completeness_status.description: complete = the full claim is supported by the surface; truncated_lower_bound = K1-detected truncation, admissible only as a lower bound (G7); partial_cross_checked = cross-check across the required surfaces is incomplete, so for single-line/fragment claims this must reach at least 2 surfaces before any load-bearing use (E3).

freeze_id.description: Freeze identifier under which this row was recorded (S0-Q1 freeze discipline); all rows consumed by one evaluation round share one freeze_id.

recorded_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of recording, before any measurement consumes the row.

factRef.description: Canonical reference to a FactRecord. This shape is IDENTICAL in FACT_RECORD_SCHEMA.json, MECHANISM_HYPOTHESIS_SCHEMA.json and RULECARD_SCHEMA.json; source of truth is FACT_RECORD_SCHEMA.json#/definitions/factRef.

fact_id.description: fact_id of the referenced FactRecord row in the immutable K1 fact log.

trust_class.description: Inherited-trust check: must equal the trust_class recorded in the fact log for fact_id. T1 refs are valid only as K1-mediated claims; T2 refs are never load-bearing (E2).
